about: The prompt card and the lyric sheet: the box and its tools, suggestions, Presets & genres, Song info, the caption a dataset supplies, the sheet with its sections, tabs, wildcards and language stamp (33-fields.mjs), with the older scenarios that exercise them.

scenarios.why: Each text field's own Ctrl+Z (F-22): the field's own texts first, then on into what the page put there (Expand), Redo the same way, a value set without telling is a step of its own, Ctrl+Z in another field never touches the box.
F-06: Ctrl+Z in the box takes back its last typing and moves the page's step that wrote it, so Ctrl+Z outside goes on back to the setting, never the words again.
Typing in the sheet is one step named for the lyrics; the sheet drawn again at Quick keeps its own history; once back at empty, Ctrl+Z goes on to the page and never puts the words back.
A song's Reuse does not write over a caption a dataset supplies, and says why in the source's own words (E-31; package 6's Reuse, finished here).
F-04: Ctrl+Z under a layer (the picker) leaves the box as it is and says why, a field in the layer with nothing of its own included; back in the box its own Ctrl+Z works.
A page write into a field no one was in (Write it for me into the lyrics) is a step of that field's own: its Ctrl+Z goes back through it to the empty sheet (F-22).

lyricSheet: the Lab tabs insert at a line boundary, the strip and a segment's caret, Instrumental read-only and the tabs refused, Expand with Undo and with none, Expand on Generate, the vocal gender, an engine with no lyrics (05-modules/lyrics).
The sheet grows a ruled line at a time, stops at its cap and scrolls with a marker on the margin and a fade at the end there is more (A-28, Q-28).
The language stamp: choosing a language leaves it where it was (L-02, E-01), and at Quick it shows while it is not the default (Q-07).

promptBox: wildcards, Expand on Generate and what Generate will do, Expand keeping focus in the box, Write it for me, its question and Replace lyrics (F-17, C-29), its toast's Undo, Song info opening with focus and closing marked.

Compose caption (empty, with BPM and key, not twice), the caption source's chips, Automatic locking the box, the locked box pointing at Edit a copy and saying why (E-31), Edit a copy and its Undo (E-06), the dataset tags on YuE2 (06-prompt-generate/minimax-caption).
Quick shows the ask and the lyric card; Studio puts the lyrics on the desk as a tile.
Ctrl+Z inside a text field is the field's while it has typing to take back, then the page's (L-05, E-18).
Lyrics and a BPM in the box are noticed; Move to lyrics and its Undo; Set the tempo field brings Tempo with that BPM; the placeholder turns while the box is empty.
Instrumental: the line count says nothing more, the tabs, Expand and the stamp stand back and say so (L-22, Q-27).
Ctrl+Z in a number box with nothing typed goes to the page's Undo, and again (L-05).
The stamp says what the language does on MiniMax-Music3; Compose caption writes it into Vocal Details (E-14, E-21).
At Quick with the source on Custom there is no From chip (E-22).
The From chip; a dataset that lacks the chosen track puts the source on Custom in the same step and says so (E-08, E-22); back on the first nothing re-locks.
YuE2 offers to set the tempo field from the box, as ACE-Step does (E-38).
One word for the main box per engine (S-05): the box is named Tags, Write it for me writes tags and says so, the Quick Sampler row follows the tags.
Tab from the box visits the tiles in reading order, the lyric sheet at the desk's head (Q-01).
Same at Quick, the sheet under the box.
Same at Lab, 1280 wide.
F-13: Move them to the lyrics sheet puts focus in the lyrics it filled.
S-07: the line count's estimate takes a BPM written in HeartMuLa's tags (src/derive/controls.ts songTempo, src/derive/fields.ts estimateTempo).
Wildcards, Expand, Write it for me and Song info (all pass), and Presets & genres.
Each field's own Ctrl+Z with the page's Undo (F-22); the same in 33-fields/field-undo-and-page-undo.
The line count's estimate on auto says it guesses (passes), and takes a BPM typed on YuE2.
E-06: Automatic follows the BPM at once; the lock line follows the tempo field in the core (src/derive/fields.ts trackNow).
S-06: the ruler's note follows a BPM typed in the box (passes) and a BPM chip.
